scope: Pinned server photo-decoder routing, actual synthetic fixtures, denied decoders, source/output guards and measured RAW costs. The original client photo was unavailable.
sourceAssociation: The hashes below identify the qualified codec source files. This document does not qualify the whole working tree or any hosted deployment.

api.detect: detectExtraImageFormat(bytes,{hint}) -> bmp|jxl|avif|raw|null; pure detector with no codec initialization
api.initialization: No top-level await. Codec imports, factory initialization and WASM compilation occur lazily inside decode.
api.outputContract: Reduced RGBA only; the separate common worker normalizes it to JPEG <=2 MiB. This module does not write to storage.
api.hintValidation: Only a short extension enum, compatible with TIFF/ORF/RW2/RAF/CR3 bytes. No full client filename or path. A JPEG signature mislabeled RAW retains signature precedence.
api.sideGuard: Native Magick width/height limits are retained and never increased (observed 33554431); optional caller maxSide may only restrict them. No new 32768-side or 8MP ceiling is imposed.

activeDecoders.versionEvidence: Runtime Magick.version/MagickFormatInfo probes retained in scratch magick-wasm/capabilities.json; exact package and loaded bytes hashed below.

policy.writers: No Magick coder write rights; RGBA is copied from pixel view. Actual BMP-write denial is tested.

activeDecoders.rawPreview: LibRaw ping extracts dng:thumbnail before full RAW raster allocation. A JPEG profile <=16 MiB is decoded by the existing Sharp JPEG Buffer loader, with orientation once and no enlargement. Visible and native sensor-page dimensions are checked before full decode.
activeDecoders.bundledButForbidden: This package includes libheif 1.23.6. It is not a HEIC/HEIF/AVIF decoder for this application; no HEIF ping/read is allowed. Actual installed policy denial is positively tested.

runtimeDeclaredVersions.aom: 3.15.2 (encoder package component; not the selected decode path)

activeDecoders.adapter: server/media/avif-original.mjs; lazy route from decodeExtraImage; first image only
activeDecoders.allocation: Low-level decoder pointer API; output is sampled directly from WASM HEAP into reduced RGBA, avoiding a JavaScript copy of full decoded RGBA. The native decoded plane may still require full WASM allocation.
activeDecoders.guard: Source dimensions/pixels and caller restrictions checked; primary-item irot/imir applied to actual decoded pixels. Unknown advisory metadata does not disable the native decoder. Fresh AVIF child test confirms Magick remains uninitialized.

activeDecoders.versionEvidence: Pinned CSP factory runtime libheif version and archive component inspection from the separate HEIC owner.
activeDecoders.adapter: server/media/heic-original.mjs (separate root-owned HEIC path, not Magick)
activeDecoders.execution: Pinned CSP asm.js factory in a restricted Node VM; no process/require supplied, codeGeneration strings:false/wasm:false. Shared plane sampler returns reduced RGBA.
activeDecoders.guard: Native coded-dimension/source 64 MP checks retained; no SPS/ispe/clap bypass.

boundedWasmMechanism.operation: Validate exact original SHA, one defined nonshared wasm32 memory with expected min/max and no imported memory; lower only memory-section maximum, preserve minimum/instructions, then validate exact derived SHA.
boundedWasmMechanism.failure: Pinned-module mismatch or allocation failure returns sanitized MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE; non-Error C++ allocation exceptions are included.

extraCodecs.syntaxChecks: node --check passed for owned module and test

extraCodecsCases: Signature-first detector and compatible RAW hints, including extended-size BMFF ftyp and high-bit nonaliases
Actual BMP/JXL/DNG reduced RGBA; source buffers unchanged
Embedded JPEG RAW preview priority and native RAW orientation 6 applied once
Actual modern AVIF in fresh child, Magick uninitialized, narrowed targetSide/maxPixels
Dimension bounds,32769x1 panorama accepted, small input not enlarged
Malformed rasters and HEIF/SVG mislabeled RAW refused
Installed Magick policy positively rejects forced HEIC/AVIF/SVG ping and read; write denied
BMP containers with appended HEIC/SVG refused without decoder fallback

rawMeasurements.scope: Synthetic CFA DNG, separate disposable Node 24.22.1 processes with --max-old-space-size=96 and final512MiB linear-heap mechanism. Metrics are observations, not a hard process RSS guarantee.
rawMeasurements.rssMeasurement: process.resourceUsage().maxRSS, KiB; /proc current RSS unavailable here

licenseNoticeInventory.meaning: Package-supplied licence/notice files identified; this is an inventory, not a legal compliance conclusion.

limits: 512 MiB is only the maximum WASM linear memory per selected decoder, not a process RSS limit; original buffers, glue, module compilation and Sharp add memory.
The parent bounds input, source pixels, conversion time and child lifetime; no continuous or hard RSS ceiling is established here.
RAW 12 MP without preview fits this measured runtime; RAW 48 MP without preview can fail availability despite being within 64 MP. Full 64 MP is allowed to try, not guaranteed to fit.
The 48 MP embedded preview fixture is only 64x48; successful preview output does not attest camera-preview quality or large real camera previews.
Synthetic tests and local Node 24.22.1 observations do not attest the unavailable original client photo, a real account/media/host, physical Safari, OS picker or telephone.
No release, deployment, preparation, CHECK or start outcome is asserted by this codec proof.
